subject: Leadership touchpoint: buying criteria, blockers & procurement path for Pioneer Health pilot
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership touchpoint: buying criteria, blockers & procurement path for Pioneer Health pilot

Oliver — thanks for taking the time today. Brief recap from our leadership-level touchpoint and proposed next steps. I pulled out the outcomes that matter to your execs and procurement so we have a single shared summary.

Key pain and business goals (what we heard)
- Latency at peak inference is blocking clinician workflow integration (target <150ms median per request).
- Unit cost per conversational session needs to be predictable for pilot-to-scale modeling.
- Data residency and auditability for PHI-like metadata is a blocker for procurement.

What success looks like for the pilot
- Run a 6-week pilot with 3 production routes (triage chatbot, discharge summarization, and clinician assist) under realistic load.
- Demonstrate 10-20% cost reduction vs current baseline through batching/caching without degrading median latency.
- Provide audit logs and SOC2 evidence needed for procurement sign-off.

Operational risks called out by your team
- Contracting timeline (CFO approval window) — you mentioned late Q2 would be ideal.
- Security controls and key management questions from legal/procurement.
- Integration points for our SDK with your analytics pipeline.

Proposed procurement path and asks for Pioneer leadership
1) Share procurement contact and core decision owners.
2) Redwood to deliver: draft SOW + pilot runbook + SOC2 extract + SLA summary.
3) Contracting touchpoint: 60-minute contract + procurement call week of 3/22 to align on terms and data handling.

Immediate next steps (action owners)
- Priya: Send draft SOW and SOC2 extract (attached) — today.
- Connor: Schedule engineering deep-dive for pilot integration (wk of 3/22).
- Marissa: Prepare customer success onboarding checklist and pilot KPIs.

Attachments: pilot-sow-draft-v1.pdf (attached), SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (attached)

Thanks again — happy to tighten any of the above. If the summary looks good, recommend we loop procurement and set the contracting call.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Leadership touchpoint: buying criteria, blockers & procurement path for Pioneer Health pilot

Priya — this is a very helpful distillation, thanks. High level confirmation:
- The latency and cost framing is accurate and will be the primary evaluation axes for our clinical ops team.
- We are comfortable with a 6-week pilot as the buy signal if technical KPIs are met.

Looping in procurement: Dana Lewis (dana.lewis@pioneerhealth.com) will own contracting and SOC/Legal review. Our CFO and final approver is Sheila Park — Sheila asked that procurement and tech show a clear runbook and deletion policy for any patient-linked metadata.

Dana, please advise on typical Pioneer attachments/clauses you need. Priya, please include KMS and data deletion language in the SOW and point us to a SOC2 extract we can share with internal auditors.

Thanks — Oliver
Oliver Grant
VP, Digital Transformation, Pioneer Health
oliver@pioneerhealth.com

From: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@pioneerhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 13:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Leadership touchpoint: buying criteria, blockers & procurement path for Pioneer Health pilot

Priya/Oliver — thanks for the summary. To move contracting we need the following items from Redwood: 
1) Formal quote with line items for pilot (compute, support, extra seats).
2) SOC2 Type II report or a vendor attestation + summary of controls (PII handling, logging, retention).
3) Proposed SLA for pilot period (availability and latency targets) and proposed remedies for missed SLAs.
4) Data deletion and key management approach (do you support customer-managed keys / KMS?).
5) Standard redline path — we will share our procurement template; can you confirm legal is OK with limited liability for pilot?

Please include Marissa/Connor on any technical attachments. We aim to complete procurement review within 3 weeks if all materials are provided.

Dana Lewis
Director, Procurement — Pioneer Health
dana.lewis@pioneerhealth.com

Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership touchpoint: buying criteria, blockers & procurement path for Pioneer Health pilot

Dana/Oliver — appreciate the clear asks. Quick updates and links below; copying internal owners who will own items on the Redwood side.

What I attached / linked (items for procurement bundle)
- SOC2 extract & controls summary: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SOC2-summary-2026 (linked)
- Draft pilot SOW (includes KMS options and deletion policy): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1pilot-sow-v1 (linked) and attached as pilot-sow-draft-v1.pdf
- Line-item quote for the pilot and optional add-ons: HubSpot deal RDW-2349 (https://hubspot.com/deal/RDW-2349)

Answers to specific procurement questions
- KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys in our Private deployment and a managed KMS option for Hosted. We detail both options in the SOW appendix A.
- SLA: For pilot we propose target median inference latency <150ms and 99.5% availability. Remedies are defined as service credits in the SOW.
- Legal redlines: We are generally OK with limited liability for a timeboxed pilot; legal has flagged data processing and indemnity language for a single cycle review.

Next steps and owners
- Dana: If these materials are sufficient, please confirm target date for procurement review and any template redlines.
- Connor: I'll set up an engineering integration call for 3/23 — 30 minutes to review endpoints and data flows.
- Marissa: Please prepare pilot success metrics and onboarding tasks for the 6-week run.
- Jonas: Stand by for pricing confirmation and any enterprise purchase order details.

I can join a procurement call with legal if that helps expedite. If everyone is aligned, propose we book a 60-minute contracting review with Pioneer procurement and Redwood legal the week of 3/22.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
